expo.name: Vendorspot
expo._note: version/runtimeVersion/versionCode/buildNumber are managed by app.config.js — bump via: npm version patch|minor|major

plugins.photosPermission: Vendorspot accesses your photo library so you can upload product images when listing items for sale, set a profile picture for your account, attach KYC verification documents, and add evidence photos when filing a dispute.
plugins.cameraPermission: Vendorspot uses your camera so you can take product photos when listing items for sale, capture a profile picture for your account, photograph KYC verification documents, and take evidence photos when filing a dispute.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Vendorspot uses your location to automatically fill in your delivery address at checkout and to help you discover nearby vendors and products on the marketplace.
